0.1: Here are the #b#t4032802# items#k. Yeesh, these're heavy. Still, I'm glad I locked down the brick maker before Nella did. Bet she's ticked off about losing that contract!

yes.0: Here, take these #b#t4032802#s#k to the #b#p1052001##k. He'll know what to do.

no.0: Hmm... Are you looking for bricks?

yes.0: These are for you. You earned them. I don't care if you don't like the color. Oh, it looks like the shoes will be too big. I guess you won't be needing them after all. That's too bad, since these are some good shoes... \r\n\nNow, come back in a moment. I have one more job for you.

npc.0: Go see #b#p1052001##k... You do know where he is, right?

lost.0: What? You lost the bricks? Lucky for you I used some leftover Mud Clumps to make some extra. Take these and be sure not to lose them again...
